_comment: Subresource-integrity manifest. `enforced` is false because no WASM binary is vendored in static/wasm/ yet, so there is nothing to hash. Vendor the binaries, replace every PLACEHOLDER with the real sha256, wire fetchAndVerifyWasm() into the loaders, then set enforced=true. verify-sri.mjs fails the build on any placeholder once enforced is true, and sri.ts refuses to return an unverified buffer regardless.
